title: Schema for the miniatures data file: every miniature sculpt (products list how many they have, in source-contents)

id.description: Id for entry: a UUID (see docs/data-model.md).

description.description: Tells apart sculpts that share a name ("2nd pose" for the Stormtroopers pack's Stormtroopers); null otherwise, and for the first sculpt. A file named after a miniature would combine name and description.

squares.description: The figure's footprint on the map, in squares: 1, 2 (1x2), 4 (2x2) or 6 (2x3).
